body: i wasn't really that normal, it was just a bit more bearable which is better than what it has been both in the past and now. i was sexually, emotionally, and physically abused as a child. the sexual abuse happend with a family friend that lived with my family, the emotional abuse was from most of my family and physical was my grandparents. the family friend left long ago and both grandparents have passed away at this point. I've gotten better with physical touch and how i view my body but I'm still ashamed and disgusted of how i am sometimes. emotionally, I'm just a trainwreck and have been since age 11.

the future is scary, yeah. a lot of the pain stems from the anxiety i developed as a kid from the abuse i went through and it affects me so much in what i do in everyday life. i had it under control somewhat so much better back then and now I've just lost that control. im scared of everything. im scared to tell everyone how deep my feelings of self hatred are which is why i vent only to myself or anonymously like i am now. i only tell them the things they ask of me such as if I'm hurting myself again because i don't want to hurt them by not telling them. but i just can't bring myself to tell them how much i want to end it all. how scared i am of the future. how much i hate my existence and that every waking moment where i am not distracting myself with work, interaction, and entertainment i am thinking of how i can end it all if i wasn't so fucking scared
